## #9 — ToddWR — 2006-06-05
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/713/post-4504>

peer,

sorry about that.
two key frames need to be set up, the only thing needing to be changed is the time parameter.  clicking the add drop button alters the wave, click it and the run the time up and down a few times to see the change in the object. the only inital state is the calm water button, so as long as the time parameter changes the waves will update

hope that helps
Todd

## #31 — tg_jp — 2008-08-20
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/713/post-24277>

Hi,

it's work as I expected. :?: I captured a demo movie, please check it.

1st part: at first, I recorded 'time' parameter: first frame -> 0.0, last frame -> 1.0. simply click 'Drop' button, that make drop at random position and power.
2nd part: create Ball object as child for setting drop positon and power. Ball's position x/z defines drop position, radius defines power. don't forget check on 'Use Ball' option before drop.
3rd part: auto drop demo. Ball's position Y defines timing for drop. don't forget to click 'register' button and 'calm' before starting animation[.
last part: to change shape of surface, with Boolean creator.  

sorry, I captured with localized version. please guess what I did with clicked position of UI. 

http://homepage.mac.com/camelio/ch_movies/ch_20080821_rippleDemo-desktop.m4v

regrads.

tg_jp, Hiroto
